# TaiwanSaver

> TaiwanSaver is a curated directory of discounts for travelers in Taiwan (Taipei first), operated by Topology Travel (真程旅行社). Travelers show a flyer at the counter to get a discount — no app, no booking, no signup, and it is free for travelers. Businesses pay nothing to list (NT$0 listing fee, NT$0 monthly fee) and are charged 10% of the original bill only on a successful redemption. Some deals are online/nationwide (e.g. travel eSIM, car rental) rather than a single Taipei address.

## How it works (travelers)
- Find a deal, save/screenshot the flyer, show it at the counter, pay less.
- Free. No app, no booking, no account.

## How it works (businesses)
- Zero listing fee, zero monthly fee (NT$0).
- Topology Travel charges 10% of the original (gross) bill only when a customer redeems, billed monthly.
- Listing and your first content update are free; each later update (change the offer, hours or photos) is NT$300 (about US$10).

## Deals
- [Yongjin Beer — 10% off your bill](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/yongjin/): Craft beer bar in Xinyi District, Taipei. 10% off the entire bill with the flyer; happy hour 2nd beer 50% off before 6pm; open daily 11:00-01:00 (Fri-Sat until 03:00); No.18 Songren Rd., Xinyi District, Taipei.
- [Placebo (安慰劑) — free welcome drink](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/placebo/): Chinese-style cocktail bar in Xinyi District, Taipei. Free welcome drink with the flyer; open daily 20:00-02:00 (Fri-Sat to 03:00); walk-ins only; No.83 Sec.2 Keelung Rd., Xinyi District, Taipei.
- [Isotope (同位素) — free welcome drink](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/isotope/): Gothic cathedral-style cocktail bar near Taipei Main Station (Datong District). Free welcome drink with the flyer; open Tue-Sun 18:00-01:00 (Fri-Sat to 02:30, Mon closed); No.101 Chang'an W. Rd., Datong District, Taipei.
- [Double 8 (岩究所) — traveler discount coming soon](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/double8/): Climbing gym in Dadaocheng (Datong District), Taipei. Traveler discount coming soon; open Tue/Thu/Fri 13:30-22:00, Sat-Sun 09:30-18:30 (Mon/Wed closed); No.251 Sec.1 Dihua St., Datong District, Taipei.
- [GoGoOut Car Rental — NT$200 free rental credit](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/gogoout/): Online car-rental platform covering all of Taiwan. New members get NT$200 free rental credit on sign-up. Foreign travelers welcome with an International Driving Permit (IDP). No physical storefront — book online.
- [QK eSIM — 15% off with code Top85](https://taiwansaver.com/deals/qkesim/): Online travel eSIM for Taiwan and worldwide. Scan a QR code to get online on arrival — no physical SIM swap. Enter code Top85 at checkout for 15% off. No physical storefront — buy online.
